contract: The importer takes explicit owner, current-site, baseline-site, operator-approval, and source-policy roots with caller-trusted exact file pins. It validates the source handoff/review/receipt and both publication, catalog, ready-packet and native result identities, then writes selected cases only to a new directory outside website and producer roots. The resulting manifest is private and explicitly not publication qualified. The pure matcher attaches only to exact current and baseline publication/result/date/map identities.
semantics: D/R/O remain native winner groups with member candidate IDs; unsupported groups are null, not invented candidates. Named pairs retain ordered candidate IDs and their conditional denominator; pair or candidate changes suppress pair deltas. Candidate support or group changes suppress winner-group deltas. Cook categories stay ordinal text without invented probabilities. Baseline source findings remain dated to the audited baseline and no difference is labeled accuracy or a causal effect.

verification.oldHandoffProbe: The exact seven-case old-release handoff projected successfully against published old House bytes using visibly invented temporary operator and source-policy approvals. Temporary output and approvals were deleted after the test. This is compatibility evidence only, not actual authorization.
verification.negativeChecks: Stale/mixed publication-result identities, missing source-policy permission, changed ordered pair, candidate-record change, inapplicable pair and D/O vs grouped R semantics.
verification.typecheck: Initially passed before the final narrow category/guard edits. Later global reruns were blocked by concurrent unrelated in-flight lib/election-night-evaluation-view.ts syntax at line 91; pending clean rerun.

limits: This is the old-release self-comparison; no corrected 16-run edition, real independent approval, source license/permission decision, public catalog, site UI attachment, or observed-election evaluation is included. The full 435x16 external ratings table was not copied.
